description: `<title>`, `<meta>` and `<link>` rendered anywhere are moved into `document.head` by React 19 and removed on unmount.
`<title>` must receive one string child; use a template literal instead of mixing text and expressions.
`react-dom` functions that warm up connections to another origin.
`preload` downloads a resource; `preinit` downloads and executes a script or inserts a stylesheet. Calls are deduplicated.
Prop on `<link rel="stylesheet">` that lets React order, dedupe and wait for stylesheets.
